title: Research on the regulation of osteogenic differentiation and mechanotransduction by porous bionic coatings on titanium alloy implant surfaces
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21381-21396
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01182A, Paper
Open Access

Zhuan Zou, Shuhan Jiang, Wenjin Chen, Yilong Wang, Qu Liang, Wei Fang, Xinli Zhan, Ronghe Gu, Quanzhi Chen
A porous biomimetic coating was fabricated on TA2 titanium alloy via MAO, whose porous structure promoted BMSC adhesion and spreading, activated mechanotransduction pathways, and enhanced implant-bone interfacial bonding.
